documentation.title: Engineering Review
documentation.summary: One Engineering Review installation with an accountable lead and six optional specialists: implementation, architecture, security, data, testing and operations. The lead selects useful specialists and owns the final assessment; Python checks evidence consistency.
prerequisites: Python 3 standard library; Unix file locking for suite coordination.
Explicit source files, criteria and actual implementer/reviewer identities.
Host-native file access; no application credentials or another provider CLI required for normal use.

quick_start.prompt: Review handler.py and requirements.txt in the supplied project. Keep source unchanged. Use the lead alone unless a specialist materially improves the review. Return supported findings and uncovered work.
quick_start.expected_result: Exact source capture, located findings or supported no-findings, and explicit coverage limits. Missing essential input yields an incomplete review.

scenarios.title: Review one function
scenarios.prompt: Review parser.py, its caller and criteria.txt; keep the target unchanged.
scenarios.expected_result: Lead-owned implementation review with exact citations and unrun checks.

scenarios.title: Review a tenant-sensitive storage change
scenarios.prompt: Review handler.py, storage.py and tenant criteria. Select security/data review only when useful.
scenarios.expected_result: Source-bound specialist results returned to the lead for deduplication, conflict resolution and coverage assessment.

verification.expected_result: The authored coordination control records prepare, dispatch, collect and synthesize. This is not an actual host or model-quality result.

troubleshooting.problem: The report is refused after a source change.
troubleshooting.solution: Preserve the old artifacts, capture current selected bytes and review the affected change before validating again.

troubleshooting.problem: The host cannot expose its exact model identity.
troubleshooting.solution: Record the requested profile and keep observed_model null; do not infer provider identity or switch accounts.

troubleshooting.problem: A nested lead has no dispatch tool or sufficient depth.
troubleshooting.solution: Use an authorized parent to dispatch selected specialist siblings and return results to the lead, or mark uncovered work incomplete. See references/host_setup.md.

documentation.support: Give the maintaining lead the exact package/source hashes, failed control or refusal and redacted evidence. Do not include credentials.

repository.text: One root skill with optional Claude Markdown and Codex TOML role assets. Host activation requires actual evidence.

testing.prepare: Keep private evidence outside source. Preserve the original 13 v1 controls and cases under evals/v1_cases.json. Freeze current evals/cases.json and evals/suite_cases.json before performing tasks. Actual observations, discovery and specialist returns remain separate from controls.
acceptance_criteria: Current mechanical suite passes; v1 preservation controls remain separately auditable.
Fresh performing tasks and public traces establish selected specialist behavior and lead synthesis.
Actual Claude Code and Codex runs are required before two-host acceptance; missing coverage stays incomplete.
improvement_steps: Locate a concrete failure, preserve its evidence and change only the responsible code or instruction.
Repeat affected controls and the same frozen behavioral task within the configured bounds.
